lines: Flirtatious female Kuva Lich voice lines.
These voice lines are affected by the weapon's element used to kill the Larvling.
- "Anyone can hack someone to pieces, but it takes a Goddess to put themselves back together again."
- "Did you know the human heads live for up to 20 seconds after decapitation? W-why do I ask? Oh, no reason."
- "Flesh - can be replaced. Limbs - exchangeable. But my broken heart, you made off with that, didn't you, little meat?"
- "When skinning a person alive, hypothermia is... a risk. The victim may die too quickly. Remember this, should we ever meet in a warm room."
- "How shocking it must have been for you, to have killed a girl, only to turn around and find the body... gone."
- "Right before someone dies, their last word is almost always "No". It was my last word to you. Re-mem-ber?"
- "The queens have ensured that I can play my games with you, and, uhm, other like you. For a long, long time."
- "If all those I've killed were alive right now, do you know what they'd say? "Let me out, let me out, where am I? Oh void, it's so dark. Ah!"
- "Do you remember me, little meat? The way you turned your fire on me - resculpting me? I'm not mad, I understand."
- "Fire runs through my body with the pain of loving you. Pain runs throughs my body with the fires of my love for you."
- "You dressed me in flame, little meat. We shall be the envy of the ball - you... and I."
- "Did you know that someone's body can burn for seven whole hours? Did you know that?"
- "If you snap-freeze and flash-fry somebody, they explode into bloody confetti. THIS is why I'm not allowed near weddings!"
- "I had a long time to think as I thawed out. Naughty little meat - naughty, naughty little meat."
- "Cold kills slowly - the last sense to go is hearing. That means the last voice you'll hear will be mine. Isn't that romantic?"
- "When you electrocuted me, my eyes exploded. Isn't that funny?"
- "With a tingle and a flash of light you granted me so many delicious new gifts. Let me thank you, little Meat. I insist."
- "I'm fully charged and ready for play time."
- "I was electrocuted. And you, naughty little Meat. You are grounded."
- "Oh little meat. Tiny serpent, with you tiny poison, did you really think you could kill a big, mean dragon? Like me?"
- "You imagine yourself toxic. I'll show you toxic!"
- "I choked down enough poison from you to kill ten normal Grineer. But a Grineer who has shared the old blood? Is no normal Grineer."
- "I am grateful for your toxin, little meat. There was a little too much blood in my poison stream."
- "Hard to get isn't a good look for you, little meat."
- "Oh you, don't be in a snit. Let's talk, you silly thing."
- Dialogue is randomly pulled from #Birth of Kuva Lich, #After Logging In, #Spawning, and #Taunts sections.

path: Navigating controlled sectors in the Star Chart
lines: - "Oh, I win! I'm having so much fun with you, little meat. Ooh, what shall we play next..."

path: Completing a Mission on an affected Node
lines: - "I didn't say you could play here. Now give me that."
- "Everyone pays in my playground, one way or another."
- "Oh, little meat. Too kind. I shall buy something lovely with this. (gasp) A germ weapon perhaps!"
- "A little treat from my little meat. Thank you darling."

path: After Revealing a Requiem Mod / Upgrade Rank of the Kuva Lich
lines: - "Clever, clever little meat. You're getting warmer..."
- "Oh, I see you. Can you see me? You're much closer now."
- "Yes, yes, you're very clever. You still haven't found me though, have you."
- "Remember how much fun we had when you killed me?"
- "I forgive you for what you did."
- "I remember every moment we've shared. Every touch, every lash, every...wound."
- "You are mine, little meat. No one else's."
- "This has to hurt, little meat. Or else, why bother?"
- "Ooh, I do love our bouts, ah-ha-ha-ha"
- "Show me what you have learned. I have learned that it takes only eight pounds of force to remove a human ear."
- "Oh, now-now-now-now. Don't make me forgive you. Not again..."
- "Oh, no you don't. Get back here."

path: One Health Bar Left / After Attacking with Correct Requiem Mod
lines: - "Oh little meat, I will not die easily. The old blood flows within me, deathless."
- "Death is my lover, little meat. She has held me closer than this."
- "Perhaps you deserve this. We both do."
- "And now I have you right - where - I want you."
- "Oh, you tried your best, didn't you? Here, let me help..."
- "I think you love me, because you want to die."
- "To think, of all those I've killed, how they gave themselves just to get little me to where I am today. Thank you, thank you all."
- "Little meat, do you see? I'm magnificent, darling. Let me - uh, let me show you."
- "The queens, they like me, they really like me!"
- "The queens, the kuva, have bestowed upon me new gifts."
- "The pain, the blood, the death. All for you, my queens. It was all for you!"
- "The queen's vision of a new Grineer, the apex made manifest - in me. Now, now, my great red work truly begins."
- "Yes! This was always meant to be mine! All my work, the long harvest, the landscapes of carrion. All! For! This! Every scream, every strangulation, every exterminated city: worthwhile."
- "Ah ha-ha-ha! You thought you had me."
- "I love you - to death. 'Til next time."
- "I know you didn't mean any of that. Farewell little meat."
- "Oh, look at you, standing up for yourself! So long, little meat."
- "My love cannot be contained any more than it can be killed. And so, I go."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "I suppose there is a time for everything. Even this. So be it."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "Oh. Little Meat. Really? The System won't be the same without you."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "Little Meat, you really cannot keep interfering like this. You know I have to stop you."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "Little Meat. This fight won't be like the last time, I can promise you that."
- "When you get to Hell, say hello to all the other Tenno I've put down."
- "Are we ready for this? Very well. Let's explore the possibilities."
- "It was always going to be this way. We were meant for each other."

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "Oh, aren't you going to introduce me to your little playmates?"
- "I was in the area, heard the screams, and thought: I'll just bet that's my little darling. And, here you are."
- "Darling, you shouldn't have! All these lovely warm bodies just waiting to be opened up like presents. I'm the luckiest girl in the system!"

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "I do so love your gift for conflict resolution. I could watch all day."
- "I just knew we could make this relationship work, ah ha-ha-ha."
- "Those mean old Queens were quite angry with me, running off with you like this. But it's worth it."

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "My apologies, darling. I must... leave you."
- "And so, I take my leave. Ahhhh..."
- "Nature. Bugs. Filth. Crawling. Hurbling. Rustling, Multi-legged Susurrations of feelers and eyes and WAAAAAAGH!""
- "You do understand that 'dirt' is just another word for filth? This entire planet is made of feculence. I'll never get clean, I'll never get clean!"
- "Oh, a small morsel? Something... light. A girl has to keep up her strength."
- "Time for a little meat, Little Meat. And then… then the main course."
- "Your delicate scent betrays you, little meat. I know you're here..."
- "Mmm, little meat. I'd know your scent anywhere."
- "Ugh, you should let a girl know they will be facing you undermatched. What am I supposed to do now, run? So undignified."
- "You've... grown. That's no fun! Time to leave."
- "You killed my lackeys, now you killed my shiniest. I liked those! I don't want to play with you anymore little meat."
- "My finest. You killed my finest. You killed my finest! I thought you liked me. I'm leaving!"
- "It would appear that I am now unaccompanied, and therefore, leaving!"
- "Why are all my men dead? Why am I now undefended? I was assured that they were the best, I cannot work like this! Goodbye."
- "Oh my. Get me down. Get me down! Get me down!"
- "Oh, please, let's move this away from the edge, hmm? I'm asking you nicely. I have to get away from the edge!"
- "No, no, no-no-no-no-no-no. Not kubrows, not kubrows!"
- "Kubrows? Noooo! No, not again, not after last time!"
- "No no, too high, too far. Get me back on the ground, get me back on the ground!"
- "Space! Who planned this? Get me out of here. Get me out of here!"
- "Oh, the little ankle-biters think they can take on the big, scary Grineer."
- "Ah ha-ha-ha! Oh, children, I'm about to teach you a very important lesson... in humility."
- "Corpus. How dull. Die, you boring little men."
- "Corpus, Corpus, Corpus- boring, boring, boring. You really, really must leave this party immediately. And, above all, violently. Thank you!"
- "Infested. Infested! Infested!! Kill it, kill it, kill it, kill it, kill it!"
- "Infested! Like a dream of everyone I've ever eviscerated come crawling back to drown me in cold, glistening innards. Die, die, die, die!"
- "Ahh, alone at last. Time to let my hair down, and slice my way into all your delicious little secrets!"
- "Those troopers were cheap and expendable anyway. You did me a favor! Now I can really cut loose."
- "That's what traitors get for talking behind my back. Summary dismissal, without references- or burial."
- "Traitor! And as for the rest of you, I'll find his little compatriots. Ohhh, yes! And when I do, oh, when I do..."
- "How could you! You know I have an unusually-high center of gravity."
- "Love and flame, little meat. Both burn, both hurt, both kill."
- "Oh, you make such a pretty candle, little meat. Such a pretty, pretty candle."
- "Aw, what a cutie little critter! I simply must kill it."
- "What is that thing? That-that four-legged thing, looking at me. Kill it! I have to kill it. Stop looking at me like that, just stop it!"
- "Armor: polished. Presentation: impeccable. I am the very vision of a modern major murderer."
- "Allow me to provide a lesson in personal style, little meat. You don't have to die shabby."
